pcs.pc_description: develop plans, actions, and standard operating procedures for the operation and administration of housekeeping department
establish and maintain housekeeping procedures, taking into consideration percent occupancy, time and use of facilities, and related public specialty areas and events
develop an inspection program for all public areas and guestrooms to ensure proper maintenance and standards are achieved and sustained
establish a training program for housekeeping department to enable positions of increased responsibility to be filled from within the department
ensure implementation of novel methods, techniques, material and equipment to improve overall operation of the department and ensure better efficiency at reduced costs
review existing procedures and policies and update them, if required
ensure proper scheduling of the department as per staff availability and daily occupancy forecast
coordinate the operation of housekeeping department to ensure minimum disruption in the overall operation of the hotel
conduct quality check to ensure cleanliness, maintenance and upkeep of all areas under the purview of housekeeping department on routine as well as surprise basis
ensure all public areas are set-up tastefully and aesthetically as per interior design standards
set-up and organize on-going deep cleaning, spring cleaning, floor and vertical surface polishing, façade cleaning schedule, etc.
ensure all preventive and corrective maintenance is carried out as per schedule
ensure that cleaning policies and procedures are properly followed in the department
conduct internal audits to ensure proper operation of the department as per the organizational standards
take corrective action on non-conformities found in audits
prepare action plans for the day-to-day functioning of the housekeeping department
identify the root cause of the problems in the department, if any and take appropriate action
make sure all special decorations during occasions or festivities are done as per organizational standards
ensure all lost & found articles are stored and distributed as per the hotel policies
coordinate with other departments to ensure delivery of quality service
attend to the complaints and queries, if any, from other departments, regarding the housekeeping functions and take necessary action
implement consistent delivery of superior customer service
ensure that the department creates a professional impression on customers
review and act on customer feedback to include customer complaints and compliments
analyze customer service reports to achieve positive and consistent results

pcs.pc_description: ensure efficient stores procedures for housekeeping department
make sure cleaning materials and guest supplies are adequate and par levels are maintained at all times
maintain strict inventory and purchase control over all controllable items
coordinate with purchase department to order supplies, material, and equipment to ensure round-the-clock availability
assist purchase department in selecting suppliers for items related to housekeeping
ensure proper documentation of the purchase and issue records
estimate the resource requirement of the department
prepare budget for the housekeeping department in accordance with the higher management
keep track of budgeted and actual departmental financial targets including revenue, stock levels, average spends and departmental profits
ensure adherence to departmental budget by allocating labor resources in line with forecasted and actual business levels, through productivity ratios and payroll management
control departmental operating costs in line with forecasted business levels while providing maximum service
analyze weekly/monthly financial status report as per organizational standards
